headline: Construction Partners Completes Georgia Acquisition
summary: Construction Partners, Inc. completed its acquisition of a business in Georgia, expanding its civil infrastructure operations along the growing Interstate 85 corridor.
why: Construction Partners is a publicly traded civil infrastructure company specializing in the construction and paving of roadways, expanding its footprint through strategic regional acquisitions.
